<style id="block-style-styles-blocks-group-clickable-card-area-css-inline-css">
.wp-block-group[class*="is-style-clickable-card"] {
	.wp-block-group.wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained {
		position: static;
	}

	&.is-nowrap .wp-block-post-featured-image {
		flex-shrink: 0;
		overflow: hidden;
	}

	&.is-nowrap .wp-block-post-featured-image img {
		height: 100%;
		object-fit: cover;
		width: 100%;
	}

	a:is( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a ):not(
			:hover,
			:focus,
			:active
		) {
		background-image: none;
	}

	a:is( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a )::before {
		content: "";
		display: block;
		position: absolute;
		inset: 0;
		z-index: 1;
	}

	&:not( :has( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a ) )
		a:is(
			.wp-block-button:first-child a.wp-block-button__link,
			a.wp-block-read-more
		)::before {
		content: "";
		display: block;
		position: absolute;
		inset: 0;
		z-index: 1;
	}

	&:not( :has( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a ) )
		a:not(
			.wp-block-button:first-child a.wp-block-button__link,
			a.wp-block-read-more
		) {
		position: relative;
		z-index: 2;
	}

	&:has( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a )
		a:not( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a ) {
		position: relative;
		z-index: 2;
	}

	&.is-stat-auto-height {
		height: auto;
	}

	&.alignleft,
	&.alignright {
		&:first-child + p {
			margin-block-start: 0;
		}
	}

	.wp-block-outermost-icon-block {
		margin-top: auto;
	}
}

.wp-block-columns:has(
		.wp-block-column:nth-child( 1 )
			> .wp-block-group[class*="is-style-clickable-card"]
	):has(
		.wp-block-column:nth-child( 2 )
			> .wp-block-group[class*="is-style-clickable-card"]

}

<style id="block-style-styles-blocks-group-clickable-card-with-background-css-inline-css">
.wp-block-group:has( .is-style-clickable-card-with-background ),
.wp-block-column:has( .is-style-clickable-card-with-background ) {
	container: clickable-card-wrapper / inline-size;
}

/* The card paints its own background, so it owns its text color: inheriting
   would go white inside a dark story type. An explicit color on the block
   still wins, being !important. */
.wp-block-group.is-style-clickable-card-with-background {
	background-color: var( --wp--preset--color--parchment );
	border-radius: clamp( 10px, 4cqw, 50px );
	color: var( --wp--preset--color--primary-text );
	container: clickable / inline-size;
	padding: clamp( 1rem, 5cqw, 4rem );
	position: relative;

	@container clickable ( width < 30rem ) {
		> * {
			margin-block-start: var( --wp--preset--spacing--sm-16 );
		}
	}

	&:has( a )::after {
		border-radius: inherit;
		box-shadow: 0 var( --wp--preset--spacing--sm-8 ) 24px
			rgba( 0, 0, 0, 0.15 );
		content: "";
		inset: 0;
		opacity: 0;
		pointer-events: none;
		position: absolute;
		transition: opacity var( --wp--custom--transition-speed--slow, 0.3s )
			ease;
		z-index: -1;
	}

	&:has( a ):hover::after,
	&:has( a:focus-visible )::after {
		opacity: 1;
	}

	.is-style-stats-large-sans,
	.is-style-stats-large-serif {
		@container clickable ( width < 17rem ) {
			font-size: var( --wp--preset--font-size--x-large );
		}
	}
}

<style id="block-style-styles-blocks-group-clickable-card-with-background-css-inline-css">
.wp-block-group:has( .is-style-clickable-card-with-background ),
.wp-block-column:has( .is-style-clickable-card-with-background ) {
	container: clickable-card-wrapper / inline-size;
}

/* The card paints its own background, so it owns its text color: inheriting
   would go white inside a dark story type. An explicit color on the block
   still wins, being !important. */
.wp-block-group.is-style-clickable-card-with-background {
	background-color: var( --wp--preset--color--parchment );
	border-radius: clamp( 10px, 4cqw, 50px );
	color: var( --wp--preset--color--primary-text );
	container: clickable / inline-size;
	padding: clamp( 1rem, 5cqw, 4rem );
	position: relative;

	@container clickable ( width < 30rem ) {
		> * {
			margin-block-start: var( --wp--preset--spacing--sm-16 );
		}
	}

	&:has( a )::after {
		border-radius: inherit;
		box-shadow: 0 var( --wp--preset--spacing--sm-8 ) 24px
			rgba( 0, 0, 0, 0.15 );
		content: "";
		inset: 0;
		opacity: 0;
		pointer-events: none;
		position: absolute;
		transition: opacity var( --wp--custom--transition-speed--slow, 0.3s )
			ease;
		z-index: -1;
	}

	&:has( a ):hover::after,
	&:has( a:focus-visible )::after {
		opacity: 1;
	}

	.is-style-stats-large-sans,
	.is-style-stats-large-serif {
		@container clickable ( width < 17rem ) {
			font-size: var( --wp--preset--font-size--x-large );
		}
	}
}

		overflow: hidden;
	}

	&.is-nowrap .wp-block-post-featured-image img {
		height: 100%;
		object-fit: cover;
		width: 100%;
	}

	a:is( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a ):not(
			:hover,
			:focus,
			:active
		) {
		background-image: none;
	}

	a:is( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a )::before {
		content: "";
		display: block;
		position: absolute;
		inset: 0;
		z-index: 1;
	}

	&:not( :has( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a ) )
		a:is(
			.wp-block-button:first-child a.wp-block-button__link,
			a.wp-block-read-more
		)::before {
		content: "";
		display: block;
		position: absolute;
		inset: 0;
		z-index: 1;
	}

	&:not( :has( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a ) )
		a:not(
			.wp-block-button:first-child a.wp-block-button__link,
			a.wp-block-read-more
		) {
		position: relative;
		z-index: 2;
	}

	&:has( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a )
		a:not( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a ) {
		position: relative;
		z-index: 2;
	}

	&.is-stat-auto-height {
		height: auto;
	}

	&.alignleft,
	&.alignright {

		}
	}

		margin-top: auto;
	}

			> .wp-block-group[class*="is-style-clickable-card"]
	)

		display: block;
		position: absolute;
		inset: 0;

<style id="block-style-styles-blocks-rt-carousel-animated-gate-vertical-css-inline-css">
.wp-block-rt-carousel-carousel.is-style-animated-gate-vertical {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: center;
	max-width: var( --wp--style--global--xwide-size );
	overflow: hidden;
	padding: 0;
	position: relative;

	> [class*="wp-block"],
	> [class*="wp-block"].block-editor-block-list__block {
		margin-inline: var( --gate-thickness );
		width: calc( 100% - ( var( --gate-thickness ) * 2 ) );
	}

	@media ( prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference ) {
		animation: var( --wp--custom--transition-speed--xxslow )
			animate-open-vertical ease-out 0.3s both;
		will-change: width;

		&.block-editor-block-list__block {
			animation: none;
		}

		> [class*="wp-block"] {
			margin-inline: -50vw;
			width: calc(
				max(
						100%,
						min( 100vw, var( --wp--style--global--xwide-size ) )
					) -
					( var( --gate-thickness ) * 2 )
			);
		}
	}

	.wp-block-cover {

		/* Fill the slide when a sibling slide is taller. A percentage
		   min-height is ignored by Firefox when sizing the slide. */
		flex-grow: 1;
		min-height: min( 90vh, 90vw ) !important;
		padding: calc( var( --gate-thickness ) * 1.5 );
		padding-bottom: calc( var( --gate-thickness ) * 2.5 );

		@media ( min-width: 782px ) {
			padding: calc( var( --gate-thickness ) * 2 );
		}

		.video-ambient-controls {
			bottom: calc( var( --gate-thickness ) * 1.9 );
			right: calc( var( --gate-thickness ) * 0.9 );
		}
	}

	.wp-block-group.is-overlay-previous {
		@media ( max-width: 781px ) {
			align-self: flex-end;
			inset: auto;
			justify-content: center;

			.rt-carousel-dots + .rt-carousel-controls {
				display: none;
			}
		}

		@media ( min-width: 782px ) {
			inset: 0 auto;
		}
	}

	&::before,
	&::after {
		content: "";
		display: block;
		background-color: transparent;
		border-radius: var( --gate-left-radius );
		box-shadow: var( --gate-left-shadow );
		height: calc( 100% - ( var( --gate-thickness ) * 2 ) );
		inset: var( --gate-left-inset );
		pointer-events: none;
		position: absolute;
		width: var( --gate-thickness );
		z-index: 1;
	}

	&::before {
		margin-left: var( --gate-thickness );
	}

	&::after {
		border-radius: var( --gate-right-radius );
		box-shadow: var( --gate-right-shadow );
		inset: var( --gate-right-inset );
		margin-right: var( --gate-thickness );
	}
}

</style>

<style id="block-style-styles-blocks-group-clickable-card-gate-hover-css-inline-css">
.wp-block-group.is-style-clickable-card-gate-hover {
	column-gap: 2rem;
	container: group-gate / inline-size;

	/* auto-fit + size container collapses tracks to 0 in Safari < 26. */
	grid-template-columns: repeat( auto-fill, minmax( 14rem, 1fr ) );
	position: relative;

	&::after {
		background-image: var(
			--wp--preset--gradient--yellow-light-blue-horizontal
		);
		border-radius: 10px;
		content: "";
		inset: calc( var( --wp--preset--spacing--sm-16 ) * -1 );
		opacity: 0;
		pointer-events: none;
		position: absolute;
		transition: opacity var( --wp--custom--transition-speed--slow, 0.3s )
			ease;
		z-index: -1;
	}

	&:hover::after,
	&:has( a:focus-visible )::after {
		opacity: 1;
	}

	.wp-block-image img {
		height: 100%;
	}

	a:is( .wp-block-post-title a )::before {
		content: "";
		display: block;
		position: absolute;
		inset: 0;
		z-index: 1;
	}

	&:not( :has( .wp-block-post-title a ) )
		a:is(
			.wp-block-button:first-child a.wp-block-button__link,
			a.wp-block-read-more
		)::before {
		content: "";
		display: block;
		position: absolute;
		inset: 0;
		z-index: 1;
	}

	&:not( :has( .wp-block-post-title a ) )
		a:not(
			.wp-block-button:first-child a.wp-block-button__link,
			a.wp-block-read-more
		) {
		position: relative;
		z-index: 2;
	}

	&:has( .wp-block-post-title a ) a:not( .wp-block-post-title a ) {
		position: relative;
		z-index: 2;
	}
}

@container group-gate ( width < 30rem ) {
	.wp-block-group.is-style-clickable-card-gate-hover::after {
		background-image: var(
			--wp--preset--gradient--yellow-light-blue-vertical
		);
	}
}

<style id="block-style-styles-blocks-rt-carousel-controls-overlay-styles-css-inline-css">
.wp-block-rt-carousel-carousel-controls[class*="overlay"] {
	margin: 0 !important;
	inset: 0;
	pointer-events: none !important;
	position: absolute !important;
	z-index: 1;

	.rt-carousel-controls__btn {
		pointer-events: all;
	}

	.rt-carousel-controls__btn--prev {
		margin-left: calc(var(--wp--preset--spacing--sm-24) * -1) !important;
	}

	.rt-carousel-controls__btn--next {
		margin-right: calc(var(--wp--preset--spacing--sm-24) * -1) !important;
	}

	.rt-carousel-controls__btn:disabled {
		background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--strokes-disabled-state);
		color: var(--wp--preset--color--white);
		opacity: 1 !important;
	}
}

.wp-block-rt-carousel-carousel:has(
	.wp-block-post-featured-image[style*="aspect-ratio:16/9"]
) {
	&:has(.wp-block-post-template.columns-2),
	&:has(.wp-block-post-template.columns-3),
	&:has(.wp-block-post-template.columns-4) {
		.wp-block-rt-carousel-carousel-controls[class*="overlay"] {
			align-items: center !important;
			aspect-ratio: 3.67 !important;
			padding: 0 !important;

			@container carousel ( width < 60rem ) {
				aspect-ratio: 3.67 !important;
			}
		}
	}

	&:has(.wp-block-post-template.columns-3) {
		.wp-block-rt-carousel-carousel-controls[class*="overlay"] {
			aspect-ratio: 5.58 !important;
		}
	}

	&:has(.wp-block-post-template.columns-4) {
		.wp-block-rt-carousel-carousel-controls[class*="overlay"] {
			aspect-ratio: 7.61 !important;
		}
	}

	@container carousel ( width < 60rem ) {
		&:has(.wp-block-post-template.columns-2),
		&:has(.wp-block-post-template.columns-3),
		&:has(.wp-block-post-template.columns-4) {
			.wp-block-rt-carousel-carousel-controls[class*="overlay"] {
				aspect-ratio: 3.67 !important;
			}
		}
	}

	@container carousel ( width < 35rem ) {
		&:has(.wp-block-post-template.columns-2),
		&:has(.wp-block-post-template.columns-3),
		&:has(.wp-block-post-template.columns-4) {
			.wp-block-rt-carousel-carousel-controls[class*="overlay"] {
				aspect-ratio: 1.78 !important;
			}
		}
	}
}

</style>

	container: clickable / inline-size;

<style id="block-style-styles-blocks-group-clickable-card-with-background-css-inline-css">
.wp-block-group:has( .is-style-clickable-card-with-background ),
.wp-block-column:has( .is-style-clickable-card-with-background ) {
	container: clickable-card-wrapper / inline-size;
}

/* The card paints its own background, so it owns its text color: inheriting
   would go white inside a dark story type. An explicit color on the block
   still wins, being !important. */
.wp-block-group.is-style-clickable-card-with-background {
	background-color: var( --wp--preset--color--parchment );
	border-radius: clamp( 10px, 4cqw, 50px );
	color: var( --wp--preset--color--primary-text );
	container: clickable / inline-size;
	padding: clamp( 1rem, 5cqw, 4rem );
	position: relative;

	@container clickable ( width < 30rem ) {
		> * {
			margin-block-start: var( --wp--preset--spacing--sm-16 );
		}
	}

	&:has( a )::after {
		border-radius: inherit;
		box-shadow: 0 var( --wp--preset--spacing--sm-8 ) 24px
			rgba( 0, 0, 0, 0.15 );
		content: "";
		inset: 0;
		opacity: 0;
		pointer-events: none;
		position: absolute;
		transition: opacity var( --wp--custom--transition-speed--slow, 0.3s )
			ease;
		z-index: -1;
	}

	&:has( a ):hover::after,
	&:has( a:focus-visible )::after {
		opacity: 1;
	}

	.is-style-stats-large-sans,
	.is-style-stats-large-serif {
		@container clickable ( width < 17rem ) {
			font-size: var( --wp--preset--font-size--x-large );
		}
	}
}

<style id="block-style-styles-blocks-group-clickable-card-area-css-inline-css">

	}

		overflow: hidden;
	}

		height: 100%;
		object-fit: cover;
		width: 100%;
	}

	a:is( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a ):not(
			:hover,
			:focus,
			:active
		) {
		background-image: none;
	}

	a:is( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a )::before {
		content: "";
		display: block;
		position: absolute;
		inset: 0;
		z-index: 1;
	}

	&:not( :has( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a ) )
		a:is(
			.wp-block-button:first-child a.wp-block-button__link,
			a.wp-block-read-more
		)::before {
		content: "";
		display: block;
		position: absolute;
		inset: 0;
		z-index: 1;
	}

	&:not( :has( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a ) )
		a:not(
			.wp-block-button:first-child a.wp-block-button__link,
			a.wp-block-read-more
		) {
		position: relative;
		z-index: 2;
	}

	&:has( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a )
		a:not( .wp-block-post-title a, .wp-block-heading a ) {
		position: relative;
		z-index: 2;
	}

	&.is-stat-auto-height {
		height: auto;
	}

	&.alignleft,
	&.alignright {
		&:first-child + p {
			margin-block-start: 0;
		}
	}

	.wp-block-outermost-icon-block {
		margin-top: auto;
	}
}

.wp-block-columns:has(

			> .wp-block-group[class*="is-style-clickable-card"]
